We apologize for the delay in announcing the remaining Summer 2026 Anime of the Season results.

This season, we've seen the highest level of vote spam in Anime Corner's history, with over 30,000 ballots invalidated so far. After excluding these ballots, the results still reflect votes from 64,000+ legitimate participants.

Our voting platform is built and maintained in-house. Alongside automated spam detection, we also manually review suspicious voting activity to keep the results fair. This has always been part of our process, and all previously announced results went through the same checks before publication.

While no public voting system is perfect, we're committed to improving ours and being transparent with the community through voting statistics and audience insights.

Due to the unusually high amount of spam, the review has taken longer than expected. The remaining results, including Anime of the Season, will be announced tomorrow. We'll also share which categories and nominees were most affected by invalid votes.

Thank you for your patience and continued support!

One Mr. Femi Awoniyi responded to Gbadebo P Rhodes-Vivour's broadcast as follows:

"It is very sad that your candidacy has constituted nothing but a distraction in Lagos politics.

Why do I say that? Because you have built your entire political career around identity politics. 

In your past Senate candidacy, you campaigned using your Igbo name, cultivated relationships with Igbo organisations, mobilised Igbo people and, in my view, played the ethnic card.

It was your legitimate right to do so. But knowing the deep misunderstanding and distrust that exist between these two ethno-national groups, you should not complain if that same card is eventually turned against you.

I think that is why your not speaking Yoruba became an issue. And I believe that your not learning Yoruba growing up was a choice, a deliberate one. I have many Igbo friends, both of whose parents are Igbo, with whom I grew up, and they all speak Yoruba.

This is why I find it difficult to understand how someone whose father is reportedly Yoruba and who, according to your biography, was born in Ikeja could have grown up without speaking Yoruba. I believe that, for whatever reasons best known to you, was a deliberate choice.

I see your candidacy as a sheer distraction. You have positioned yourself as the alternative to the APC in Lagos, but, in my view, you are not a credible alternative. For there is very little in your biography or professional experience that suggests you have the capacity to govern Lagos.

The APC cannot and should not govern Lagos forever. Unfortunately, I believe you are hindering the emergence of a unifying alternative through your identity-driven politicking.

That is a fact and it is very unfortunate."

Picture: L: Gbadebo R: Femi Awoniyi
